ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel core with high-intensity (white/light-grey) distal zones; macro-level ratio estimated at 65% low-intensity to 35% high-intensity pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity (black) central blob spanning the peduncle connection and inner lobes. High-intensity (white) contiguous areas located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Extensive high-frequency mottling and pixel-level intensity variance (focal spots) throughout the intermediate zones of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 42 degrees; bounding-box depth is roughly 12% of the total visible vertical fluke extent.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations observed along the continuous trailing edge; highest pixel-amplitude variations (peaks and valleys) are localized on the distal 30% of each lobe boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a concave sweep trajectory towards the tips; visible leading edges show a distinct convex mathematical curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 10 high-contrast circular dark-ring pixel clusters (rosette formations) localized on the high-intensity distal surface of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct low-intensity vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions (scratches) mapped across the white pigmentation of the distal right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized biological encrustations (barnacles) visible along the leading edges and extreme distal tips; circular scarring corresponding to former barnacle attachment points on the right fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy concentrations of high-relief, heterogeneous biological accretions forming a rough-textured fringe along the lateral lobe tips.
